name: NetNordic AAL-DC1 Aalborg (ex-Lytzen IT)
notes: Directory/Inflect lists AAL-DC1 at 1 Langagervej, Aalborg, operated by NetNordic with reported 1.5 MW; NetNordic acquired Lytzen IT (2022) incl. Aalborg/Hjorring/Copenhagen locations. No municipal planning record opened this run; kept as C-grade colocation lead in North Denmark (thin market, no hyperscaler campus confirmed).

name: Green DC heat-reuse demonstration at Aalborg University
developer: Energy Cluster Denmark / Aalborg University / Heatflow / R&R Consult
notes: Innovation project Green DC seeks CO2-neutral server cooling and surplus-heat delivery to district heating; data-center-related R&D activity rather than a commercial facility.

name: Apple Foulum/Viborg Data Center
notes: Apple newsroom states Viborg data centre operational (45,000 sqm, European services); Danish Computerworld covers opening; localplan nr. 460, VVM and emergency-power environmental approvals per Viborg Kommune records per methodology. Capacity not disclosed (MW null).

name: Kolo DK2 Aarhus
notes: Operator page lists DK2 Aarhus on Silkeborgvej, N+N power redundancy, 100% renewable energy (operator-stated facility facts).

name: Kolo DK1 Skanderborg
notes: Operator page lists DK1 Skanderborg near Aarhus, Tier 3-ready colocation, N+N redundancy, 1.25 PUE, renewable power (operator-stated facility facts).

name: Kolo DK4 Viby J
notes: Operator page lists DK4 in Viby J near Aarhus, 100% Danish renewable energy colocation (operator-stated facility facts).

name: itm8 (ex-Sotea) Silkeborg DC
notes: Directory leads place itm8/Sotea DC at Vejlsøvej 51, Silkeborg; no clean operator facility page or Silkeborg Kommune permit record opened this run, so remains C/B lead per methodology (frostcore.net unreachable).

name: Google Fredericia Data Center
notes: Google location page: data centre online since 2020, renewable energy; Baxtel (C/B) estimates first building ~145,000 sqft, EUR 600m investment. Capacity MW not officially disclosed.

name: Meta Odense Data Center
notes: Meta info sheet (A) lists Odense with 10bn+ DKK investment, 2017 groundbreaking, Tietgenbyen; Ramboll: ~45 MW surplus heat to district heating. Expansion-cancellation remains B-grade trade-press history.

name: Bulk DK01 Esbjerg Campus
notes: Bulk operator page (A) markets DK01 Esbjerg campus; DCD/Baxtel report initial ~20 MW support across ~50,000 sqm (Baxtel now lists 12 MW; DataCenterJournal 18,546 sqft). Capacity figures vary by phase; kept 20 MW with B grade noting source discrepancy.

name: Prime Data Centers Esbjerg AI-ready campus
developer: Prime Data Centers / Brunswick Real Estate
notes: Prime announcement (A) and BeBeez trade coverage (B): first phase 160 MW IT with potential expansion to 550 MW IT, subject to demand/permitting; Esbjerg Municipality lists data centers as strategic priority.

name: atNorth DEN02 Varde (Ølgod) Mega Site
notes: atNorth operator page: 171-hectare Varde greenfield campus, 500 MW campus power capacity for colocation and build-to-suit; DCD earlier reported 250 MW Ølgod plan with completion targeted end-2026.

name: Thylander Data Centers Esbjerg hyperscale project
notes: DCD: fully Danish developed/operated hyperscale DC in Esbjerg, 100 MW plan, initial 10-20 MW, expansion potential to 200 MW, launch target 2026; no municipal permit record opened this run.

name: University of Southern Denmark Sonderborg AI supercomputer data center
developer: University of Southern Denmark / Danfoss / HPE
notes: Danfoss/SDU/HPE AI supercomputing data center in Sonderborg brought online (HPE AI Mod POD modular DC); institutional research facility, not commercial colo.

name: Microsoft West Denmark (Esbjerg/Varde, incl. Lunde Campus)
notes: Microsoft official announcement (A) names Esbjerg and Varde municipalities for planned West Denmark region; directory lead (C) shows Microsoft Lunde Campus on a 79-hectare site between Lunde and Nørre Nebel (4 data halls) and Byggvärlden Nordic construction list (C) shows new-build Varde with 2027-12-01 target. Status announced/planned - not operational.

name: Apple Kasso/Aabenraa second Denmark data center
notes: Apple canceled planned second Danish data center at Kasso/Aabenraa (June 2019), 285-hectare site put up for sale; recorded as rejected historical project.

name: Microsoft Denmark East - Hoje-Taastrup campus
notes: Microsoft announced Denmark East launch 2026-03-26 naming Hoje-Taastrup, Koge, Roskilde; Microsoft Local confirms Hoje-Taastrup construction. Region operational per Microsoft (A); physical campus-level permits per Hoje-Taastrup Kommune pending.

name: atNorth DEN01 Copenhagen (Ballerup)
notes: atNorth operator page (A): DEN01 in Ballerup, 30 MW capacity for high-density workloads, first phase live Q4 2025, heat reuse, Tier 3 standards; DCD (B) corroborates 30 MW plan.

name: STACK Infrastructure COP02 Copenhagen/Taastrup
notes: STACK operator page (A): COP02 in Copenhagen/Taastrup designed for 72 MW critical capacity across two buildings (48 MW + 24 MW); status planned/development per operator.

name: Digital Realty Copenhagen Campus (CPH2/CPH3 Ballerup)
notes: Digital Realty operator pages (A) list Copenhagen metro data centers incl. Ballerup CPH2/CPH3 (~251,500 sqft / 23,300 sqm colocation space); ownership post-Interxion/GlobalConnect transactions per methodology verification note.

name: Kolo DK5 Copenhagen
notes: Kolo operator page (A): DK5 Copenhagen centrally located retrofit colocation for compute-intensive/liquid-cooled workloads, ultra-low-latency connectivity.

name: GlobalConnect Taastrup CPH1
notes: GlobalConnect operator page (A) for Nordic colocation offering; DataCenterJournal/Inflect (C) place CPH1 at 3 Hørskætten, Taastrup, carrier-neutral, ~63,152 sqft; exact address from directories so facility-level evidence B/C.

name: Equinix Copenhagen (CP1/CP2 metro)
notes: Equinix Europe colocation page (A) confirms Copenhagen presence; Check-Host and Data Center Map (C) reference Equinix CPH facilities/IX. Specific CP1/CP2 IBX pages returned 403 in prior checks - facility-level details U pending manual verification per methodology.

name: Microsoft Denmark East - Koge and Roskilde campuses
notes: Microsoft Denmark East launch (A) names Koge (Lille Skensved) and Roskilde (Gadstrup/Finervej) campuses; Computerworld (B) details diesel storage at Koge campus buildout; Microsoft Local confirms Roskilde construction start; DCD reports second-phase Koge construction.

name: GARBE Data Centers Business Park Falster AI campus
notes: Guldborgsund Municipality (A) conditional land sale at Business Park Falster near Norre Alslev, 35 ha; expected 350 MW, up to DKK 20bn investment, 10-15 year phased build (A/B trade coverage).
